task_groups.group_description: Initialize the project environment, configure tooling, and establish the foundational structure.

tasks.title: Set up project structure and initial configurations
tasks.description: Initialize the project directory, configure package management, set up TypeScript, and define the core technology stack.
subtasks: Create project directory with necessary subdirectories (e.g., `src`, `dist`, `tests`).
Configure `package.json` with initial dependencies.
Set up `tsconfig.json` for TypeScript.
Specify technology stack choices (e.g., React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express).
Create basic project files (e.g., `index.html`, `main.ts`).

task_groups.group_description: Develop the core application features, UI components, and associated documentation in parallel.

tasks.title: Implement Backend and Core App Logic
tasks.description: Develop the server-side logic, API endpoints, and state management for the todo list application.
subtasks: Implement API endpoints for adding, deleting, and updating todo items.
Implement correct state management for the application's data.
Apply Repository Pattern for an abstraction layer between data access and business logic.
Implement idempotent API endpoints to handle retries and network failures gracefully.
Add input sanitization and validation on the backend.
Implement comprehensive error handling with meaningful API error responses.
Use structured logging with appropriate log levels and contextual information.

tasks.title: Implement UI Components and Frontend Logic
tasks.description: Build the user interface components, ensuring they are functional, responsive, and follow modern frontend practices.
subtasks: Create functional and responsive UI components for the todo list, input form, and item display.
Use functional components and hooks in React for better state management and reusability.
Implement immutable state updates to prevent side effects and simplify debugging.
Implement error boundaries in React to handle UI errors gracefully.
Leverage service workers to provide offline functionality for a PWA experience.

tasks.title: Create Comprehensive Project Documentation
tasks.description: Generate detailed documentation covering setup, API usage, and system architecture to ensure maintainability.
subtasks: Create `README.md` with setup instructions and usage examples.
Create `API.md` to document all API endpoints, including request/response formats.
Create `ARCHITECTURE.md` to explain the system design, data models, and key components.

task_groups.group_description: Perform parallel quality checks including testing, security auditing, and code quality review.

tasks.title: Write Unit, Integration, and E2E Tests
tasks.description: Develop a comprehensive test suite to ensure code correctness, validate workflows, and prevent regressions.
subtasks: Write unit tests to cover 80%+ of the codebase using Jest.
Use React Testing Library to write component tests.
Write integration tests to validate key workflows between frontend and backend.
Write E2E tests using Cypress to ensure critical user paths function correctly.
Implement contract testing (e.g., Pact) to prevent API integration issues.

tasks.title: Perform Security Checks and Validation
tasks.description: Audit the application for common security vulnerabilities and ensure best practices are followed.
subtasks: Scan for dependency vulnerabilities using Snyk or npm audit and resolve them.
Validate that security best practices (e.g., OWASP Top 10) are followed.
Check for Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities from user input.
Review authentication and authorization mechanisms if applicable.

tasks.title: Run Code Quality and Best Practice Checks
tasks.description: Enforce coding standards, linting rules, and type safety to maintain a high-quality, readable codebase.
subtasks: Configure and run a linter (e.g., ESLint) to ensure code quality tools report no major issues.
Enforce strict type checking with TypeScript to catch type-related errors.
Implement a mandatory code review process for all pull requests.
Verify that code is well-structured and follows established design patterns.

task_groups.group_description: Automate the build and deployment process for continuous integration and delivery.

tasks.title: Configure CI/CD and Deploy Application
tasks.description: Set up a continuous integration pipeline and configure deployment to a hosting platform.
subtasks: Configure a CI pipeline (e.g., using GitHub Actions) to run tests and builds automatically.
Containerize the application using Docker for consistent deployment environments.
Set up automated deployment to a platform like Vercel, Heroku, or AWS.

execution_order.note: Setup phase - sequential. Must be completed before any other work begins.
Implementation phase - parallel. Backend, frontend, and documentation work can occur simultaneously.
QA phase - parallel. Testing, security, and quality checks can run simultaneously after implementation is complete.
Deployment phase - sequential. Final deployment after all code and QA tasks are finished.

risks: Potential integration issues between UI components and state management.
Dependency vulnerability may require additional time to resolve.
Ensuring security compliance across all features may introduce delays.
State management inconsistencies could lead to UI bugs.
API version mismatches between frontend and backend.
mitigations: Use established state management patterns like Flux or Context API with useReducer.
Proactively use tools like Snyk or npm audit for dependency scanning.
Integrate security checks early in the development cycle.
Utilize immutable state update patterns and strong typing with TypeScript.
Implement contract testing (e.g., Pact) to ensure API contracts are not broken.
